components.css: .ds-primary {font: 12.75px "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; min-height:42px; padding:7.5px 12.75px; border:1px solid var(--line,#b9bfb0); border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent,#35513c);color:var(--on-accent,#faf9ef);border-color:var(--accent,#35513c)} .ds-primary:hover {background:var(--ink,#2d4033);color:var(--surface,#eeeee5)} .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #35513c); outline-offset: 4px; }.ds-primary:disabled {opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

components.css: .ds-secondary {font: 12.75px "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; min-height:42px; padding:7.5px 12.75px; border:1px solid var(--line,#b9bfb0); border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#2d4033)} .ds-secondary:hover {background:var(--soft,#e0e4d8);border-color:var(--accent,#35513c)} .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #35513c); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Named palette swatch
components.description: Ink, wash and accent samples on the palette paper, with a visible name.
components.css: .ds-palette {background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#2d4033);border:1px solid var(--accent,#35513c);border-radius:2px;padding:2.25px;width:78px;cursor:pointer} .ds-swatch {display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:27px;background:#f4ecdd;border:1px solid #c0b9ad;padding:3px} .ds-swatch i {display:block;width:7px;height:15px;background:#23201d} .ds-swatch i:nth-child(2) {width:17px;background:#603a1a} .ds-swatch i:nth-child(3) {width:5px;height:10px;background:#b12e23} .ds-palette-name {display:block;font:12px/1.2 "Segoe UI",sans-serif;margin-top:4.5px} .ds-palette:hover {border-color:var(--accent,#35513c)} .ds-palette:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #35513c); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Settings disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure for the optional page settings.
components.html:
On the page

The garden can appear on the left or right.
components.css: .ds-details {border-top:1px solid var(--line,#b9bfb0);color:var(--ink,#2d4033);width:260px} .ds-details summary {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:44px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font:16.5px var(--serif,Baskervville,Georgia,serif)} .ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker {display:none} .ds-details summary::after {content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);margin-right:4.5px} .ds-details[open] summary::after {transform:rotate(225deg)} .ds-details summary:hover {color:var(--accent,#35513c)} .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #35513c); outline-offset: 4px; }.ds-details p {font:12.3px/1.5 var(--sans,"Segoe UI",sans-serif)}

components.name: Masthead links
components.description: Links to technical specimens and the source repository.
components.css: .ds-nav {display:flex;gap:22.5px;font:12.75px var(--sans,"Segoe UI",sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#2d4033)} .ds-nav a {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;color:inherit;text-underline-offset:.24em;text-decoration-thickness:1px} .ds-nav a:hover {text-decoration-thickness:2px} .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #35513c); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The playground follows the approved interactive botanical plate direction. Generated engraving and wash drawings provide its illustration. Fine rules and restrained controls surround a page preview that pairs a garden with text.

English names identify the public choices. Historical French names remain secondary information. Plant thumbnails and named palette swatches let visitors inspect choices before selecting them.
keyCharacteristics: Generated engraving and wash drawings provide its illustration.
English names identify the public choices.
dos: Do use generated gardens as the primary artwork.
Do show English names alongside visual choices.
Do show palette names and swatches together.
Do preserve the SVG aspect ratio when adjusting page margins.
Do leave advanced controls inside their disclosures.
donts: Don't replace the botanical artwork with generic decorative illustrations.
Don't use historical French terminology as the sole label for a public control.
Don't rely on colour alone to distinguish selected controls.
